title: Evolution
alt: Ceramic snail sculpture with human-like teeth and an iron chain
description: A compromised environment forces the gastropod into a grotesque, human-like morphology—a consequence of anthropocentric impact.

title: Residuum
alt: Empty ceramic oyster shell among sand and synthetic maritime debris
materials: Ceramic, natural sand, scoop-net, acrylic, found object
description: A degraded shoreline where an empty oyster shell loses its organic flesh and is left among synthetic maritime refuse.

title: Decay
alt: Slug sculpture among moss, plastic, and a discarded bottle
materials: Clay, preserved moss, plastic, water bottle, warning sticker
description: Commercial plastic infiltrates the soil and creates a toxic contrast with living green moss.

title: Toxification
alt: Mutated ceramic fish displayed over printed scientific imagery
description: Pustules, scales, and lacerations map fatal aquatic mutations and invasive experimentation.

title: Delicacy
alt: Ceramic bear paw staged as a plated delicacy
materials: Ceramic, acrylic paint, porcelain plate, salt, black pepper
description: Culinary staging masks a mutilated limb, indicting commodification and human desire.

title: Skin of Envy
alt: Ceramic snake constrained by plastic wrap and a barcode
description: Commercial packaging suffocates the reptile and links snakeskin to luxury consumption.

title: Echoes of Wrath
alt: Cephalopod sculpture marked by concentric plastic rings
materials: Ceramic, synthetic plastic rings, acrylic paint
description: Concentric scars visualize the destructive frequencies of naval sonar imposed on underwater habitats.

title: Feeding Gluttony
alt: Large chicken sculpture penetrated by a mechanical feeding tube
materials: Cardboard, natural straw, corn, wooden dowels, plastic
description: A feeding tube turns the animal into a manufacturing asset engineered for accelerated consumption.

title: Trophy of Greed
alt: Wireframe stag head pierced by multiple hunting arrows
materials: Wooden dowels, acrylic paint, Blender 3D-printed joints
description: A structural stag head is pierced by arrows, reflecting the pursuit of dominance and trophy status.

title: Theatre of Pride
alt: Cetacean sculpture leaping through an artificial ring of flame
description: A captive cetacean is turned from an individual life into mass spectacle and entertainment.

title: Two Seconds of Gravity
alt: Frog sculpture pinned beneath the tread of a car tire
materials: Ceramic, Blender 3D-printed tire matrix, acrylic paint
description: Synthetic tire tread conveys urban oppression as the trapped amphibian loses its ability to jump.

title: Packaged Relic
alt: Elephant tusk form constructed from financial newspaper print
materials: Ceramic, foamboard, wooden rod, newspaper, fabric thread
description: Financial media constructs a poached tusk, showing wildlife converted into commercial capital.

title: The Rusted Howl
alt: Ceramic wolf head with industrial screws replacing its teeth
description: An apex predator is discarded on urban stone, its evolutionary fangs replaced by machinery.

title: Infrastructure of Silence
alt: Bird nest sculpture beneath a model of electrical infrastructure
materials: Branches, coconut fiber, wire, fractured eggshells
description: Transmission infrastructure looms over a fragile nest and exposes unseen hazards within local ecosystems.

title: Imprisoned Freedom
alt: Wire eagle held tightly by a large 3D-printed human hand
description: An eagle engineered for open sky is anchored by a human hand—an emblem of forced subjugation.
